Short Version

I am Ben Børilden, a Process Engineer with a chemistry background and a long list of side interests. This website is where those interests can become something more durable than scattered files, bookmarks, and half-finished ideas.

The main threads are photography, computer-related experiments, gaming, and whatever I learn while turning this static site into a more maintainable Astro project.
